metric_name: 物理风险 (极端天气/海平面)
query: 物理风险 (极端天气/海平面) 物理风险 (极端天气/海平面) 衡量企业识别、评估与管理极端天气、海平面上升等气候物理风险的能力。 重点考察：风险识别完整性、资产暴露评估深度、适应措施与业务连续性安排。 内容质量得分 • 2分：系统识别急性和慢性风险，覆盖关键资产/供应链，有量化暴露评估、适应措施及应急恢复机制。 • 1分：有风险识别与原则性措施，但缺少系统化评估或具体实施路径。 • 0分：无相关披露。 气候物理风险 急性物理风险 慢性物理风险 极端天气 暴雨 洪水 沿海洪水 台风 风暴潮 热浪 长期高温 干旱 野火 海平面上升 降水模式变化 资产暴露 气候适应 业务连续性 韧性措施 physical climate risk acute physical risk chronic physical risk extreme weather heavy precipitation flood coastal flooding typhoon storm surge heatwave chronic heat drought wildfire sea level rise changing precipitation patterns asset exposure climate adaptation business continuity resilience measures 企业识别了哪些急性物理风险（如台风、洪水、热浪）？ 是否识别海平面上升、长期高温等慢性风险？ 是否评估关键资产、运营点或供应链暴露？ 是否披露适应措施、加固改造或应急恢复安排？ 是否有量化暴露或损失评估？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物理风险 (极端天气/海平面)'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业识别了哪些急性物理风险（如台风、洪水、热浪）？ 是否识别海平面上升、长期高温等慢性风险？ 是否评估关键资产、运营点或供应链暴露？ 是否披露适应措施、加固改造或应急恢复安排？ 是否有量化暴露或损失评估？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有转型风险（政策、诉讼、融资）；仅有减排目标；仅有泛化气候风险管理而无物理风险内容；仅有社区防灾公益项目而无企业资产风险；区分：物理风险聚焦极端天气与海平面等物理影响及适应措施；转型风险聚焦政策法律资金变化；场景分析是评估方法，可服务物理与转型风险，但不能替代具体物理风险识别与适应披露；TCFD披露是框架完整性，不等于本指标内容充分。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety
results.text: The Group has a strong responsibility towards our passengers and employees to ensure safety on ferries and ships. We have formulated and implemented the Safety Management Manual for Ships and other standards and guidelines to guide employees on daily maintenance and inspection to ensure the proper functioning and safe operation of ferries and ships. We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. In order to enhance the contingency preparedness and situational awareness of the subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, we conduct emergency exercises simulation exercises are regularly conducted such as spill collision, stranding of ferry and hull damage simulation. Safety training is carried out periodically to foster a safety awareness culture and to ensure that the Group's safety standards are communicated effectively. During the Reporting Period, there was no case of significant safety accident in passenger transportation.

We have formulated and implemented the Safety Management Manual for Ships and other standards and guidelines to guide employees on daily maintenance and inspection to ensure the proper functioning and safe operation of ferries and ships. We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. In order to enhance the contingency preparedness and situational awareness of the subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, we conduct emergency exercises simulation exercises are regularly conducted such as spill collision, stranding of ferry and hull damage simulation. Safety training is carried out periodically to foster a safety awareness culture and to ensure that the Group's safety standards are communicated effectively. During the Reporting Period, there was no case of significant safety accident in passenger transportation.

results.section: About the Group / Approach to Sustainability
results.text: Another major business of the Group is the waterway passenger transportation business. The cross-border high-speed waterway passenger transportation based in Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao, has developed into the largest operation agent of waterway passenger transportation in the region. The Group also operates five inner harbour and outlying island ferry routes in Hong Kong. The fuel supply business of the Group mainly focuses on the provision of diesel and lubricants for passenger ferries and cargo vessels, and other businesses of the Group cover the operation and management of facilities maintenance services for properties in Macao.

Another major business of the Group is the waterway passenger transportation business. The cross-border high-speed waterway passenger transportation based in Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao, has developed into the largest operation agent of waterway passenger transportation in the region. The Group also operates five inner harbour and outlying island ferry routes in Hong Kong. The fuel supply business of the Group mainly focuses on the provision of diesel and lubricants for passenger ferries and cargo vessels, and other businesses of the Group cover the operation and management of facilities maintenance services for properties in Macao.
